title: Non-Decreasing Colorful Path
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: All input values are integers.; 2 \le N \le 2 \times 10^5; N-1 \le M \le 2 \times 10^5; 1 \le A_i \le 2 \times 10^5; The graph is connected.; 1 \le U_i < V_i \le N; (U_i,V_i) \neq (U_j,V_j) if i \neq j.
